prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Atlanta to replace my air conditioner?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” company for every Atlanta home, but **PV Heating, Cooling & Plumbing** looks like a strong first call for an AC replacement: local listings show about a **4.9-star rating with thousands of reviews**, and specifically note full-system replacement work.

I’d also get quotes from **Estes Services** and **Empire Heating & Air Conditioning**. They’re well-reviewed Atlanta-area options with replacement or installation services, so comparing them can help you judge price and scope.

Before choosing, get **three written, itemized estimates** and compare the equipment model and size, installation work, labor and parts warranties, permits, and any ductwork or electrical changes. Ask each contractor for their Georgia conditioned-air contractor license number and verify it with the state. Don’t choose on star ratings alone—or assume a larger unit is better.
